question: A man borrowed a sum of ₹30,000 at 7.5% per annum simple interest. How much money (in ₹) will he pay at the end of 5 years to clear his debt?
solution:
Given:

Principal (P) = ₹30,000

Rate of interest (R) = 7.5% per annum

Time (T) = 5 years

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI
